configuration.candidate: frozen boundary-exact and world-terminal; same production files as current local memory/terminal-retention candidate
configuration.method: Complete native fresh invokeInto path; 128MiB working storage, 3 warmups + 9 single-call samples/process, 3 rotating processes per format/case/window, two windows after builds finish. Separate allocation replay. Compilation/encoding before timing, separately recorded producer_ns.
configuration.oracle: scalar=42, deep=67, install n=n*(n+1)/2; same source builder apart from module import spelling
configuration.decision: Measure full control-family scaling, complete image bytes and allocation/copy costs against optimized BPC1; disclose losses. This control slice alone cannot close the whole matrix.

sources.selected: Add canonical-word-sets.patch to the Boundary input; World production is unchanged by the set experiment.

word.mechanism: Sparse membership within aligned 64-ID words uses one canonical bitmap leaf instead of binary member/run subtrees; contiguous sets remain single runs.
word.evidence: 64-installation full path ~0.925ms vs optimized BPC1 ~0.237ms; 1.478MB prepared storage of 1.589MB full peak; Prepared.init 2128/3714 CPU samples with recursive set operations dominant
word.target: at least 20% lower full invocation median on install64 in two rotating windows; lower peak working allocation; no repeatable tiny/value regression beyond matched control noise
word.laws: same extensional sets and canonical roots independent of insertion order, read-only overlays, allocation failure safety, u64 high IDs and bounded traversal, constant-size monotonic prefixes
word.alternative: Separating resizable pool storage from the arena could reduce retained allocator slack but would not remove the sampled recursive set work; keep separate attribution.
word.scope: one internal analysis-set representation; no wire or admission-rule change

layout.parent: 64-bit word leaves, which increased Node from 40 to 48 bytes on native targets
layout.intervention: One untagged payload union, selected by canonical bounds/cardinality: interval when count=span, word when the remaining set lies in one aligned word, tree otherwise. Hash/equality inspect only that derived payload.
layout.target: retain word-leaf speed reduction while removing its fixed node-size increase on scalar/install1/install8; same benchmark and set oracles
layout.guardrails: canonical constructors must select the derived payload; no union reinterpretation based on caller input, no loss of u64 members or wasm32 support

packed.parent: word-layout ordinary union: measured 48-byte node, failed the compact-layout objective
packed.intervention: explicit payload layout selected only by canonical constructors and derived bounds/cardinality; deterministic hash key contains semantic fields only, never union padding
packed.preservation: same run/word/tree normalization and exact set tests; full native and wasm32 checks required
packed.target: 40-byte native node, 32-byte wasm32 node; retain speed benefit without small-case memory increase from node width

index.baseline: original tree sets and packed word leaves, measured separately
index.intervention: Store only stable immutable node IDs in the interning hash table. Hash/equality for incoming nodes read the single owning node array through adapted lookup; table growth hashes existing IDs with the same semantic hash.
index.target: at least 25% lower peak allocation for install64 versus its corresponding before variant; remove the bitmap tiny/value memory regression while preserving timing gains
index.laws: no duplicate canonical roots, correct table growth after node-array relocation, immutable-base lookup, allocation failure cleanup, no pointer escape or stored self-reference
index.limits: Pool remains sequential and its read-only base must stay immutable/alive; this changes private lookup storage, not admission authority or wire identity

profile.workload: install64, 10000 complete invocations with independent result checks; native sample over five seconds after one second startup

phases.qualification: One instrumented diagnostic replay; input decoding and final output encoding are outside this phase breakdown, so phase timings are not acceptance timings.

disposition.selected: packed word leaves plus node-ID interning retained locally after exhaustive set checks and full Boundary/current World validation
disposition.limits: Control64 remains slower and larger than optimized BPC1. The complete required matrix, actual Agent gains and serial reviews remain open. No overall performance acceptance is claimed.
disposition.packageOracle: The packaged capacity test now explicitly sets working budget=1; assuming install64 must exceed the default budget was invalidated by the memory improvement.

world.package: explicit limited-budget failure, unchanged input and retry pass from extracted runtime

validation.scope: Boundary source 58bf6fb133e7d5bba1210c6ad64cd59f51755620; World normal-pin aggregate passes without overrides. Agent qualification follows publication.
